children: Brazil's central bank said on Wednesday it will offer a total of up to $1 billion across two simultaneous dollar auctions with repurchase agreements on Thursday.

The central bank said in a statement the auctions will start at 10:30 a.m. local time (1330 GMT). The repurchases for the auctions are set for February 2 and April 2 next year, according to the monetary authority.
